text:
For ten cents I bought it on the corner

and an ungainly angel sold it to me;

when I set about sharpening it

I saw it as a small and sturdy cannon.


The lead sprang out exploding ideas

and again the sad angel sharpened it.

I went out with it and a face of high bronze

hauled it from my memory. Distracted


I tossed it in my bag among handkerchiefs, letters,

dried flowers, coloring tubes,

bills, slips and nougats.


I was going I don't know where and violently

some vehicle lifted me, and my bag

kept knocking with its bomb inside.

translation.title: For Ten Cents I Bought It on the Corner...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the pencil as both writing tool and explosive device.
